user.title: Connect ÖkoFEN Pellematic
user.description: Enable the JSON interface on the boiler's touch panel first (General settings → Network → JSON mode "On", not "compatible").

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the boiler in your network.
data_description.port: Port of the JSON interface, usually 4321.
data_description.password: Password of the JSON interface. This is not the password of the ÖkoFEN web portal.
